tooltipGithub.description: Footer icon tooltip - link to the source repository.

tooltipHelp.description: Footer icon tooltip - opens the online help page.

tooltipSettings.description: Footer gear-icon tooltip - opens the settings page.

btnCancel.description: Generic dialog button - dismiss without acting.

btnSave.description: Dialog button - save the current bar before switching.

popupShowCommons.description: Popup checkbox label - also list bars marked as common in the switcher.

popupRowLoaded.description: Tooltip on the bar row that is currently active in the bookmark bar.

popupRowSwitch.description: Tooltip on an inactive bar row - click it to load that bar.

popupUnsavedChanges.description: Tooltip on the dot marking the loaded bar as having unsaved edits.

popupCommonBar.description: Tooltip on the icon marking a row as a common bar.

popupSaveInPlace.message: Salva le modifiche alla barra in questo set
popupSaveInPlace.description: Tooltip on the save icon shown on the dirty loaded row.

popupDirtySwitch.message: Salvare le modifiche a "{loaded}" prima di passare a "{target}"?
popupDirtySwitch.description: Dirty-switch prompt when moving from one bar to another. {loaded} and {target} are bar names.

popupDirtySave.description: Dirty prompt when no target bar is named. {loaded} is the current bar name.

optionsHeaderSuffix.description: Suffix after the app name in the settings page header and tab title.

optionsLanguageLabel.description: Label for the UI-language picker in settings.

optionsLanguageAuto.description: First option in the language picker - follow the browser's language.

optionsBarsHeading.description: Heading of the bars-management section in settings.

optionsBarsHint.message: Trascina una barra per riordinare. Contrassegna una barra come comune per rendere i suoi segnalibri disponibili ad altre barre. Per ogni barra non comune, scegli quali comuni anteporre e in quale ordine.
optionsBarsHint.description: Explanatory hint under the Bookmark bars heading.

optionsNewBarPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the create-bar text input.

optionsAddBar.description: Label of the button that creates a new bar.

optionsGripTitle.description: Tooltip on the drag handle of a bar card.

optionsLoadedTag.description: Tag shown on the bar card that is currently active in the bar.

optionsCommonSet.message: Contrassegna come barra comune (i suoi segnalibri possono essere anteposti ad altre barre)
optionsCommonSet.description: Tooltip on the common toggle when the bar is not yet common.

optionsCommonUnset.description: Tooltip on the common toggle when the bar is already common.

optionsAddToAll.message: Aggiungi questa barra comune a ogni altra barra
optionsAddToAll.description: Tooltip on the + button of a common bar card.

optionsRemoveFromAll.message: Rimuovi questa barra comune da ogni altra barra
optionsRemoveFromAll.description: Tooltip on the − button of a common bar card.

optionsExportOne.message: Esporta questa barra in un file
optionsExportOne.description: Tooltip on the per-bar export icon. The file format comes from the Import & export section picker.

optionsDeleteBar.description: Tooltip on the per-bar delete icon.

optionsCannotDeleteLast.message: Non è possibile eliminare l'ultima barra
optionsCannotDeleteLast.description: Tooltip on the delete icon when only one bar remains (disabled).

optionsNoCommons.message: Nessuna barra comune ancora. Contrassegna una barra come comune per usarla qui.
optionsNoCommons.description: Empty-state text in a bar's commons picker when no common bars exist.

optionsCommonsLabel.description: Label above the per-bar list of selected common bars.

optionsRemoveFromBar.description: Tooltip on the ✕ that removes a common from a bar's selection.

optionsAddCommonOption.description: Placeholder option in the dropdown that adds a common to a bar.

optionsAddCommonBtn.description: Button that confirms adding the selected common to the bar.

optionsDeleteConfirm.message: Rimuovere questa barra dei segnalibri e tutti i suoi segnalibri?

optionsDeleteRemove.description: Confirm button of the delete-confirmation modal.

optionsDirtyDiscardApply.description: Button that discards unsaved edits and applies the config change.

optionsDirtySaveApply.description: Button that saves unsaved edits then applies the config change.

optionsRemergeDirty.message: La barra attualmente caricata "{title}" ha modifiche non salvate. Salvarle, scartarle o annullare questa modifica di configurazione?
optionsRemergeDirty.description: Dirty prompt shown when a settings change would re-merge the loaded bar. {title} is the bar name.

optionsExportFailed.description: Alert prefix when a JSON export fails; followed by the error detail.

optionsImportFailed.description: Alert prefix when applying an import fails; followed by the error detail.

errorMissingSets.description: Error thrown when an imported JSON file has no top-level sets array.

errorNoBars.description: Error thrown when a single-bar import file contains zero bars.

optionsImportNewBar.description: Label of the button beside Add bar that imports a bar from a file as a new dated copy.

optionsImportNewBarTitle.message: Importa una barra da un file come nuova copia — non sostituisce mai una barra esistente.
optionsImportNewBarTitle.description: Tooltip on the Import bar button beside Add bar.

optionsIoHeading.description: Heading of the settings section holding the file-format picker and the Import button.

optionsIoHint.message: Scegli il formato di file utilizzato dal pulsante di esportazione su ogni barra. JSON è un backup completo — ripristina anche i collegamenti della barra alle sue barre comuni. Gli altri formati sono testo leggibile che puoi incollare ovunque e mantengono solo cartelle e collegamenti. L'importazione accetta qualsiasi di questi formati e rileva quello giusto dal file.
optionsIoHint.description: Explanatory hint under the Import & export heading.

optionsFileFormatLabel.description: Label beside the dropdown that selects the export file format.

optionsFileFormatTitle.message: Formato utilizzato durante l'esportazione di una barra. Le importazioni rilevano il formato dal file stesso.

errorUnknownFormat.message: Tipo di file non riconosciuto. Supportati: {list}
errorUnknownFormat.description: Error shown when an imported file has an extension no format claims. {list} is a comma-separated list of extensions such as .json, .md - do not translate it.

tooltipRefreshIcons.message: Aggiorna icone dei segnalibri mancanti (Shift+clic: tutti)
tooltipRefreshIcons.description: Popup footer button. Re-fetches the favicons of the bookmarks on the bar.

popupRefreshingIcons.description: Progress shown on the refresh button while it runs. {done} and {total} are counts.

popupRefreshIconsDone.description: Result shown on the refresh button. {fixed} is how many icons actually arrived, {visited} how many pages were visited.
